objective: 在不使用已打开Phase43 blind标签的前提下，从1200个全新且请求区间不重叠的BurstGPT窗口生成Qwen3纯PD Hfull/H0开发数据，并训练带有界残差、alpha收缩和H0硬保护门的DNN

execution.environment: local CPU worktree with explicit Git-external protected raw input

selection_contract.embargo: exclude any interval overlapping Phase27/28/30/31/32/33/34 selections or Phase41/43 blind windows
selection_contract.mooncake: no fresh non-overlapping Mooncake interval remains after the historical 300-second embargo; this expansion is BurstGPT-only

teacher_contract.source: Phase41 scheduler-faithful teacher validated against 4853 GPU requests and 6849 chunks
teacher_contract.label: topology-independent 12-bin sender-counted logical calls and bytes per 1000 requests
teacher_contract.complete_request_storage: used in memory only; never written to Git

predictor_contract.candidate_selection: five-fold OOF within 960 expanded_train profiles only
predictor_contract.validation: 240 expanded_validation profiles evaluated once after candidate+alpha freeze
predictor_contract.residual: Phase42 total+shape encoding with tanh bounds: total +/-log(2), shape logits +/-2

feature_modes.fixed_draining_causal: remove rps/interarrival/peak-to-mean/fano arrival features because fixed-draining communication is arrival-time invariant
feature_modes.full_target_free: all non-constant feature_* and H0 inputs

hard_acceptance_gate.oof: selected positive-alpha candidate must strictly beat H0 on calls histogram WAPE, bytes histogram WAPE, mean calls TV and normalized payload EMD
hard_acceptance_gate.validation_overall: the frozen model must again strictly beat H0 on the same four metrics
hard_acceptance_gate.validation_segments: each of three segments must have composite ratio <1.0 and neither calls nor bytes histogram WAPE may exceed 1.05x H0
hard_acceptance_gate.negative_policy: if any gate fails, save the expanded dataset and honest model result but set model_accepted=false and prohibit a new blind phase
hard_acceptance_gate.pass_meaning: workflow integrity can PASS independently of scientific model acceptance

stop_and_block_if: HEAD is not exact W44, a pinned input or any of six raw hashes differs, or selection reproduction differs
any selected interval overlaps another selected interval or an embargoed historical/blind interval
Phase43 labels, raw rows, complete request pairs, GPU, network, model weights or caches are accessed by the predictor
candidate/alpha selection reads the 240 validation targets or a hard gate is relaxed after results
raw trace rows or complete requests would enter Git
claim_boundary: Phase44 can establish expanded-development improvement and permit a later fresh blind freeze; it is not itself new blind evidence
the dataset and model cover Qwen3-8B pure P1-D1 and BurstGPT only
no claim is made for the other five models, physical RDMA time, placement, latency or online scheduling
